allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 18, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 10 : 41, i.e 10 Equity Shares for every 41 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 230 per share.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
